about: Records whose values in the two-build comparison differ from the baseline build on purpose: the baseline is wrong there. compare_builds.py accepts a difference only for a listed (database, variant, kind, record) and prints how many it accepted. Remove the entries when the baseline tag moves past the fix.

changes.reason: The baseline returned cached values that depend on the calculation order: the reactants of a reaction-defined substance are calculated with the gas pressure correction on, and shared the cache with the plain calculations. The new values equal the values without memoization (all 2928 checked). Test: pytests/test_calculation_order.py.
